title: AffectEMAState
description: Dual Exponential Moving Average (EMA) state for person-level affect smoothing. Tracks fast (α=0.5) and slow (α=0.1) EMA for valence and arousal. Reference: ADR-0012d (k003d)

v_fast.description: Fast EMA for valence (α=0.5, ~2-3 event window)

a_fast.description: Fast EMA for arousal (α=0.5, ~2-3 event window)

v_slow.description: Slow EMA for valence (α=0.1, ~10-20 event window, baseline mood)

a_slow.description: Slow EMA for arousal (α=0.1, ~10-20 event window, baseline activation)

last_update.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of last EMA update

n_observations.description: Total number of observations used to compute EMA (for confidence/initialization tracking)
